data.long_meaning: In Greek, 'Kora' means 'maid' and 'Bella' means 'beautiful' or 'pure'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'kora' and is commonly used in the Western world. It symbolizes purity and beauty. The name Corabella carries the meaning “Maids, pure one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Corabella usually hope their child will grow to embody maids, pure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: קורבלה

in_hebrew.long_meaning: קורבלה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'לב שומע' או 'קול פנימי'. השם קורבלה נגזר מהמילים 'קור' שפירושו 'לב' ו'בלה' שפירושו 'יפה' או 'שומע'. השם משקף את הרעיון של לב שומע ומגיב לקול האלוהים או לקול הפנימי.

in_greek.name: Κοραμπέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κοραμπέλα προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Corabella και σημαίνει 'καρδιά που ακούει' ή 'καρδιά μου'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την ιδέα της καρδιάς ως κέντρου της πνευματικής και ψυχικής ζωής.

in_latin.name: Corabella
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Corabella origine Latina est et significat 'cor mentis' vel 'vox interna'. Hoc nomen ex vocibus 'cor' quod significat 'cor' et 'bella' quod significat 'pulchra' vel 'audiens' derivatur. Nomen hoc reflectit ideam cordis quod audit et respondet voci Dei vel voci internae.

Historically, the name Corabella has been used in Christian traditions to symbolize spiritual sensitivity and inner guidance.

In literature, the most famous Corabella is from a short story by Hans Christian Andersen titled 'The Nightingale'. Beyond being a beautiful name, it implies having a connection to the classical and cultural influences of ancient Greece.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Corabella' carries deep significance as it represents the idea of beauty and purity in a deeper, holistic sense. The 'Kora' in the name connects the bearer to the inner wisdom and divine feminine energy that is thought to bring harmony and balance to one's life. The name Corabella thus evokes a sense of inner beauty, refinement, and spiritual depth. Embracing this name can inspire a deeper connection to oneself and one's spiritual journey.
